description_en: Used by developers to obtain membership information in business scenarios that depend on CatGenie Membership
description_zh: 用于开发者在依赖于猫精会员的业务场景下获取会员信息
name: GetAccountForApp

fields.help_en: Phone number of the authorized membership user
fields.name: phone

fields.help_en: User identifier, which can be set to userOpenId or userUnionId
fields.name: id

fields.help_en:
Type of User ID:  
OPEN_ID: The default user ID identity.  
UNION_ID: Organization-dimension user ID identity. This value is available only after an organization has been requested on the Tmall Genie Skill Application Platform
fields.help_zh:
用户Id的类型
OPEN_ID：默认的用户ID标识。
UNION_ID：组织维度的用户ID标识，在天猫精灵技能应用平台申请过组织后才会有该值
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the user identifier for Tmall Genie, and each way corresponds to a different encoding type:  
PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name, used for the Android application customer link.  
SKILL_ID: Skill ID, used for the cloud-based link
fields.help_zh:
编码类型，获取天猫精灵的用户标识的途径有多种，不同途径对应不同的编码类型
PACKAGE_NAME：apk包名，Android应用客户链路的编码类型。
SKILL_ID：技能ID，云端链路的编码类型
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en:
Value corresponding to the encoding type:  
When the encoding type is SKILL_ID, the value is the application's Skill ID.  
When the encoding type is PACKAGE_NAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client app
fields.help_zh:
编码类型对应的值
编码类型是SKILL_ID时，其值为应用的Skill ID。
编码类型是PACKAGE_NAME时，其值为对应客户端App的packageName
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en: Organization ID. This field is required if IdType is set to UNION_ID
fields.name: organization_id

fields.help_en: Device ID, set to deviceOpenId or deviceUnionId
fields.name: id

fields.help_en:
Type of the device ID:  
OPEN_ID: Default device ID identifier  
UNION_ID: Device ID identifier at the organization dimension. This value is available only after an organization has been requested on the Tmall Genie Skill Application Open Platform
fields.help_zh:
设备Id的类型 
OPEN_ID：默认的设备ID标识
UNION_ID: 组织维度的设备ID标识，在天猫精灵技能应用平台申请过组织后才会有该值
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the device ID for Tmall Genie, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type.
PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name, used in the Android application customer flow.
SKILL_ID: Skill ID, used in the cloud-based flow
fields.help_zh:
编码类型，获取天猫精灵的设备标识的途径有多种，不同途径对应不同的编码类型。
PACKAGE_NAME：apk包名，Android应用客户链路的编码类型。
SKILL_ID：技能ID，云端链路的编码类型
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en:
Value corresponding to the encoding type:  
When the encoding type is SKILL_ID, the value is the application's Skill ID.  
When the encoding type is PACKAGE_NAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client app
fields.help_zh:
编码类型对应的值

编码类型是SKILL_ID时，其值为应用的Skill ID。
编码类型是PACKAGE_NAME时，其值为对应客户端App的packageName
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en: Organization ID. Required if IdType is UNION_ID

RetCode.description_en: Error code returned. A value of `0` indicates success
RetCode.description_zh: 返回的错误码，`0`表示成功

RetMsg.description_en: Error message returned. No message is returned upon success
RetMsg.description_zh: 返回的错误信息，成功则不返回信息

IsVip.description_en: Indicates whether the user is an authorized member

VipExpireAt.description_en:
Millisecond-level UNIX timestamp.

If the user has activated membership, returns the membership expiration time.
If the user has never activated membership, the value is always `0`
VipExpireAt.description_zh:
毫秒级时间戳

若开通过会员，返回会员失效时间。
若从未开通过会员，返回值固定为`0`
VipExpireAt.title_zh: 若以前开通过会员，返回会员失效时间，若从未开通过会员，此字段为0
